definitions: A border crossing point between India and Bangladesh, specifically located near Akhaura, Bangladesh, and Agartala, India.
A customs and immigration facility situated at the international boundary between Akhaura and Agartala.
examples: The Akhaura Check Post is a vital trade route.
Travelers often use the Akhaura Check Post to cross the border.
Security was heightened at the Akhaura Check Post.
